record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, compute training-only item frequencies f_i=log1p(count_i)/max_j log1p(count_j), and scale historical item embeddings by 1-0.3*f_i. Keep padding zero and candidate embeddings unchanged. This previously helped under BPR; test whether suppressing common historical items also helps the current pointwise objective. Save the fixed frequency vector as a checkpoint buffer for identical inference. Preserve embedding parameters, topology, readout, loss and optimizer.

category_rationales.rationale: For each category, compute normalized log item frequencies solely from training interactions and scale historical item embeddings by 1-0.3*f_i. This tests whether suppressing common historical items improves the current pointwise objective. Preserve learned embeddings, causal convolutions, readout, loss, optimizer and candidate embeddings. Store the fixed scales in a checkpoint buffer; the existing predictor writer imports the updated model class and loads that buffer automatically.
